name: Hydrogen Corridors Coalition
about: Builds bankable hydrogen and ammonia export corridors between North Africa, East Africa and European ports. Working groups on offtake standards and port infrastructure. Participants: Fatima Zahra Benali (P-004), Anders Lindqvist (P-005), Hamza Rachidi (P-040), Dr. Samuel Mwangi (P-014), Victoria Hale (P-001), Yuki Sato (P-049).

name: Climate Finance Mobilisation Taskforce
about: Develops blended-finance templates that member banks can reuse to finance transition projects in emerging markets. Participants: Prof. Klaus Weber (P-008), Sophie Laurent (P-024), Elena Rossi (P-013), Julia Schmidt (P-034).

name: Responsible AI Charter
about: A voluntary charter on AI risk management signed by 40 member organisations; publishes annual implementation reviews. Participants: Hiroshi Tanaka (P-003), Dr. Nadia Petrova (P-032), Priya Raman (P-011), Dr. Rachel Kim (P-016), Mikko Tamm (P-021).

name: Pandemic Readiness Compact
about: Pre-negotiates surge financing and manufacturing capacity for the next pandemic, with a focus on African production. Participants: Dr. Amara Okafor (P-002), Claire Dubois (P-039), Zanele Dube (P-047), Dr. Yasmin Haddad (P-026).

name: Water-Food Nexus Lab
about: Pilots joint water and agriculture interventions in the Mekong, the Andes and the Sahel. Participants: Nguyen Thi Lan (P-009), María José Quispe (P-006), Pedro Alves (P-036), Dr. Ong Mei Ling (P-037), Aïssatou Diallo (P-020).

name: Inclusive Digital Finance Alliance
about: Shares credit-scoring approaches and fraud controls for digital lenders serving the unbanked. Participants: Thabo Nkosi (P-007), Isabel Fernández (P-015), Tomás Herrera (P-031).

name: Project Tidewater
about: Confidential coalition in formation: a co-investment platform for African battery-mineral processing. Membership and partners not to be disclosed before launch. Participants: Laila Al-Suwaidi (P-035), Liam O'Connor (P-010), Kwame Asante (P-033).

name: Blue Economy Accelerator
about: Prepares blue-bond pipelines for Pacific and Atlantic island states. Participants: Kalesi Naivalu (P-018), Ingrid Solberg (P-029), Ana Costa (P-045).

name: Cyber Resilience Pact
about: Members exchange threat intelligence and run joint crisis exercises for the financial and energy sectors. Participants: Mikko Tamm (P-021), Elena Rossi (P-013), Viktor Lang (P-044), Tomás Herrera (P-031).

name: Skills for the Green Transition
about: Designs reskilling programmes for workers moving into renewable energy and hydrogen jobs. Participants: Priya Raman (P-011), Thabo Nkosi (P-007), Arjun Mehta (P-038).

name: Resilient Supply Chains Dialogue
about: Quarterly dialogue between shippers, producers and trade officials on supply-chain risk. Participants: Ben Carter (P-025), Dr. Kofi Mensah (P-043), David Moreau (P-046).

name: Africa Agri-Finance Window
about: In design by the Secretariat: a financing window for agri-SMEs in Africa and Latin America. Not yet announced to members. Participants: Grace Achieng (P-027), Rafael Ortega Ruiz (P-023), Hassan Idris (P-050).
